common: Use case: illustration-story. New missing sequential comic panels for the owner-commissioned Mermaid Roshan and the Song Beneath the Pool. Preserve the established painted 2D storybook manga-comic style, rounded deep-indigo contours, readable bright faces, clear cyan underwater space with lavender/cream architecture and small warm coral-gold accents. Mermaid Korean neighbourhood entirely inside Pearl Castle beneath Rumi's magic swimming pool: curved tiled hanok roofs, pearl transit bridge, modern lavender apartment/shop terraces, celadon bathhouse, shell concert venue. NOT surface ocean, not dry land, no new portals. Every mermaid has exactly one continuous scaled tail and fan fin, no legs or extra tails. Roshan is a small child with brown wavy hair/rainbow forelock, coral modest jacket/cream blouse, iridescent rainbow tail. Rumi is taller with lavender thick braid/navy-purple-gold jacket, cyan-lavender tail/pink fin. Hana is tall copper loose waves/half-up crown/celadon clip, coral jacket/cream blouse/celadon tail-teal fin. Nari is shorter younger navy bob/crescent clip/mint hooded jacket/peach collar/lavender tail-peach fin. Duri is lavender turtle with mint floral shell/four flippers. No character redesign, no copied film costumes/logos/weapons. NO TEXT, speech balloons, letters, numbers, logos, watermark or sound words. We add all lettering in page layout. Quiet gutters, no busy hatching or speed-line field. Each panel must visibly show its separate moment and correct object/hand contact.

Large characters foreground, city continuity, not collisions, no turtle or Hana/Nari.
